name: Meet Team
title: Meet Team
description: A perspective portrait fan with smooth GSAP spring motion, pointer exploration, touch dragging, and customizable team content.
summary: Introduce your team with aligned portraits that turn in perspective as you explore. Configure member content, portrait geometry, and spring motion through props. Stable member ids preserve motion across parent renders; pointer exit settles the selected portrait, and newly loaded teams start in the middle.
highlights: Centered portrait fan inspired by editorial team sections
Continuous spring motion with configurable stiffness, damping, and mass
Mouse exploration, touch dragging, card selection, and keyboard navigation
Configurable member content, portrait layout, and spring motion
Responsive sizing, image fallbacks, empty state, and reduced motion
Scoped GSAP cleanup and an idle ticker that stops when settled or hidden
anatomy: Header with customizable title and subtitle
Perspective stage with accessible portrait buttons
Selected member details and optional profile link

physics.description: A substepped spring integrates position and velocity toward the selected portrait. GSAP quick setters update only transforms. The fan compresses spacing with the cosine of each portrait angle to keep alignment consistent. Motion stops at rest and when hidden.

accessibility.aria: Named portrait buttons expose their selected state. A roving tab stop keeps keyboard navigation short. Selected member details are announced politely. Navigation controls have explicit labels.

keyboard.description: Reach the selected portrait, profile link, and navigation controls.
Select and focus the previous or next portrait.
Select and focus the first or last portrait.
Select a portrait or activate a navigation control.

accessibility.reducedMotion: Disables pointer-follow motion and spring interpolation. Explicit selections update immediately while all controls remain usable.

recommended: Agency, studio, and company team sections
Editorial portfolios with a small group of people
bestPractices: Use unique, stable member ids and equally sized portrait images.
Supply accurate names and roles; imageAlt can describe the portrait.
Provide your own members with stable ids; new arrays and content edits preserve in-flight motion.
Use showControls on touch layouts and keep damping high for restrained motion.
Pass trusted profile links and image URLs.

props.name: members
props.description: Team members with unique, stable id, name, role, image, and optional imageAlt, imagePosition, and href. Fresh array references and content edits preserve the spring and active drag. When selection is unavailable, the middle member is selected. Pass an empty array for the empty state.

props.name: title
props.description: Section heading.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Supporting text. Use an empty string to hide it.

props.name: cardWidth
props.description: Maximum portrait width in pixels (100–360), fitted to the available width and height.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Portrait width divided by height (0.6–1.2).

props.name: gap
props.description: Spacing between portraits in pixels (0–64).

props.name: tilt
props.description: Maximum fan rotation in degrees (0–70).

props.name: depth
props.description: Recession per card in pixels (0–100).

props.name: perspective
props.description: Perspective distance in pixels (500–2400).

props.name: borderRadius
props.description: Portrait corner radius in pixels (0–40).

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Spring tension (60–600). Higher values follow input faster.

props.name: damping
props.description: Spring friction (10–80). Lower values allow more overshoot.

props.name: mass
props.description: Spring mass (0.5–3). Higher values feel heavier.

props.name: grayscale
props.description: Display portraits in black and white.

props.name: followPointer
props.description: Move the fan as the mouse moves across it. Disabled for reduced motion. Drag, click, and keyboard selection remain available.

props.name: showDetails
props.description: Show the selected name, role, and optional profile link.

props.name: showControls
props.description: Show previous/next buttons and member count.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes for the section, including surface color and dimensions.

props.name: cardClassName
props.description: Additional classes for portrait buttons.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible carousel label.

props.name: onMemberChange
props.description: Called when the selected member changes through pointer, drag, click, or keyboard input.
